_notes: Some findings cite code refs (styles.css, index.html, dashboard.js); I did not open them. Rated from screenshots, ARIA/probe descriptions and context only.

ratings.note: Seen on each switch to manual (per reservoir job); causes doubt about a next step but the goal (dosing off) is met.
Deuteranopia capture shows all dots olive; colour-blind volunteers on every rota cannot do core task 3 and there is no workaround on the page.
Departs from suggested 3: forced-colours mode is a Windows setting not available on the bay iPad or phones named in context, and the status sentence still gives the state.
Comprehension cost for new volunteers and visitors; trained growers unaffected and readings still carry 'In range'.
Departs from suggested 4: blocks status entirely for screen-reader users, but context places screen-reader use at home, so use in the bay is uncertain.
First section sits directly under the nav; the mismatch costs almost nothing in practice.
Same harm as the colour-only status findings: the faulty sensor is not identifiable for colour-blind or screen-reader users.
Green 'Topped up' next to a red float about the same tank leaves the grower unable to decide whether to act.
Critical journey: after any reload on the shared tablet the screen shows automatic dosing with no cue; risk of dosing into a drained tank and of misleading the next grower.
Feed drop-outs are expected; with no stale state growers may act on old 'In range' values.
Faint clock time only; volunteers who do not know when a reading is stale must compare against a clock at every glance.
Landmark noise for screen-reader users only; table still reachable.
Chart gives shape only; the current value is on the card, so only history reading suffers.
Same as the other pump-control message finding; confusing but does not block taking dosing off automatic.
When a reading drifts, volunteers whose job is to act on it get no range or next step on screen.
Mapping Conductivity/EC probe/EC 1.8 costs novices time but is learnable.
Pump log lines run on from the status text; times resolve it but add doubt at the critical confirmation.
Evidence confirmed: deuteranopia capture makes red float indistinguishable; core task blocked for colour-blind growers on every rota.
Duplicate of the chart-scale finding; history unreadable, current value still available.
Amber 'Warm' reads as a flag to most, but whether it is out of range is ambiguous.
At the moment a fault occurs, untrained volunteers have nothing on screen to act on.
'In range' answers the main question; missing ranges hide drift towards limits, learnable from the checklist.
